evidence_rule: A public license badge is not proof that the publisher owns the original clinical images or can authorize cloud use; unprovided evidence remains false. Research-only and noncommercial use terms take precedence.

candidates.name: Panoramic-Dental-Xray-FDI
candidates.evidence: Roboflow shows 1,577 images, 32 labels 11-48 and CC BY 4.0, but About says 'A description for this project has not been published yet'; no acquisition source/clinic rights or consent/waiver chain.

candidates.name: Panoramic Dental Xray Dataset v3
candidates.publisher: Brahmi, Jdey, Drira / Université de Kairouan
candidates.source_identity: Two dental clinics in Sidi Bouzid, Tunisia; 2023 originals; v3 includes 107 instance-segmented + 60 tooth-type (8 classes) + 54 additional panoramics.
candidates.evidence: Original study and depositor are identified; v3 is CC BY 4.0, but class-specific annotations of 32 FDI permanent tooth positions not established, clinical image rights and permission to upload to third-party GitHub runners not documented.

candidates.name: MICCAI STS2024
candidates.source_identity: Children's dental panoramic X-rays sourced from Zhang et al. 2023; repository says research purposes.
candidates.evidence: Peer-reviewed challenge describes 2,380 train panoramics with only 30 fully annotated and 2,350 unlabeled; public GitHub says publicly available for research purposes.

candidates.name: TL-pano
candidates.publisher: University of Surrey, University of Sao Paulo et al.
candidates.evidence: Zenodo record explicitly states 'This dataset is for non-commercial research purposes only'; 197 annotated / 114 nonannotated, files restricted. Not eligible for Digital Crown commercial training.

candidates.name: InReDD PAN924
candidates.source_identity: 924 anonymous OPGs with ~20,033 FDI tooth bounding boxes; project approval needed.
candidates.evidence: Requires credentialing, data-use agreement and author-approved study. User requested models/data without asking individual commercial permissions.

candidates.name: Dataset for Automating Dental Condition Detection on Panoramic Radiographs
candidates.publisher: Eftimie et al., Iuliu Hațieganu University
candidates.published_license: Zenodo CC BY 4.0, separate data usage terms indicate NON-COMMERCIAL and no redistribution
candidates.source_identity: 1628 university clinic OPG plus 180 outside validation; rights catalog notes additional noncommercial research DUA.
candidates.evidence: Independent systematic research inventory reports CC BY 4.0 with separate database agreement restricting to noncommercial educational/research uses. Also not 32-class FDI; no train.

candidates.name: AKUDENTAL
candidates.source_identity: 333 expert-annotated panoramic films, images not yet uploaded.
candidates.evidence: Original GitHub author states noncommercial CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and pending publication/upload.

candidates.name: Panoramic Radiography Dataset v2
candidates.source_identity: 3,000 OPGs with masks and COCO annotations; no verified explicit FDI-32 numbers
candidates.evidence: NLM catalog advertises 3,000 panoramics CC BY 4.0, but does not establish individual FDI-32 labels or underlying clinical rights for commercial cloud training.
